title: How to Reserve a Spot for an Event
content:
If a user asks how to reserve an event:

- Guide them to the CultPass app
- Instruct them to browse the experience catalog and tap 'Reserve'
- If it's a premium or limited event, check if reservation confirmation is required via email
- Remind them to arrive at least 15 minutes early with their QR code visible

**Suggested phrasing:**
"You can reserve an experience by opening the CultPass app, selecting your desired event, and tapping 'Reserve'. Be sure to arrive 15 minutes early with your QR code ready."

title: What's Included in a CultPass Subscription
content:
Each user is entitled to 4 cultural experiences per month, which may include:
- Art exhibitions
- Museum entries
- Music concerts
- Film screenings and more

Some premium experiences may require an additional fee (visible in the app).

**Suggested phrasing:**
"Your CultPass subscription includes 4 curated experiences each month. You can choose from museums, concerts, film events and more. Premium events may have an extra cost, which is shown during reservation."

title: How to Cancel or Pause a Subscription
content:
Users can manage their subscription via the app > 'My Account' > 'Manage Plan'.

- Cancel: Effective at the end of the billing cycle
- Pause: Preserves user data, resumes automatically when reactivated
- Do NOT offer refunds unless approved by support lead

**Suggested phrasing:**
"You can cancel or pause your subscription at any time via the 'My Account' section in the CultPass app. Cancelation takes effect at the end of your billing cycle."

title: How to Handle Login Issues?
content:
Most login issues are resolved with password reset:

- Ask the user to tap 'Forgot Password' on the login screen
- Ensure they are using the correct registered email
- If they did not receive the reset email, check spam folder or retry after 10 minutes
- For persistent login issues, escalate to human support

**Suggested phrasing:**
"Try tapping 'Forgot Password' on the login screen. Make sure you're using the email associated with your account. If the email doesn't arrive, check spam or try again in a few minutes."

title: How to Update Your Payment Method
content:
If a user needs to update their payment method:

- Direct them to the CultPass app > 'My Account' > 'Payment Settings'
- They can add a new credit/debit card or link a PayPal account
- The old payment method will be removed once the new one is verified
- If their current payment has failed, remind them to update within 7 days to avoid service interruption
- For corporate or group billing, escalate to the billing team

**Suggested phrasing:**
"You can update your payment method by going to 'My Account' > 'Payment Settings' in the CultPass app. Add your new card details and the old method will be removed once verified. Please update within 7 days if your last payment failed to avoid any service interruption."

title: Understanding Your Monthly Billing Cycle
content:
CultPass billing works on a monthly cycle starting from the date of subscription:

- Billing occurs on the same day each month (e.g., subscribed on March 15 = billed every 15th)
- If the billing date doesn't exist in a shorter month, billing occurs on the last day
- Users receive an email receipt within 24 hours of each charge
- Past invoices are available in 'My Account' > 'Billing History'
- If a charge appears incorrect, advise the user to check their billing history first

**Suggested phrasing:**
"Your CultPass subscription is billed monthly on the same date you subscribed. You can view all past invoices under 'My Account' > 'Billing History'. If you see an unexpected charge, please check your billing history first."

title: How to Request a Refund
content:
Refund policy for CultPass:

- Refunds are only issued for cancelled experiences that were not rescheduled
- Users must request a refund within 14 days of the cancelled experience date
- Refunds are processed to the original payment method within 5-10 business days
- Subscription fees are non-refundable unless there was a billing error
- For billing errors (e.g., double charges), verify the issue in the billing system before processing
- Always confirm the refund amount and reason before processing

**Suggested phrasing:**
"Refunds are available for cancelled experiences that weren't rescheduled, requested within 14 days. The refund will be processed to your original payment method within 5-10 business days. Could you provide more details about the experience you'd like a refund for?"

title: Troubleshooting App Crashes and Errors
content:
If a user reports the CultPass app crashing or showing errors:

- First, ask them to update the app to the latest version from the App Store or Google Play
- If already updated, suggest clearing the app cache: Settings > Apps > CultPass > Clear Cache
- For persistent crashes, ask the user to uninstall and reinstall the app
- Ensure their device OS is supported (iOS 15+ or Android 11+)
- If the issue persists after all steps, collect the device model, OS version, and error message, then escalate to the technical team

**Suggested phrasing:**
"Please try updating the CultPass app to the latest version. If it's already up to date, try clearing the cache in your device settings. As a last resort, uninstalling and reinstalling usually resolves most issues."

title: How to Update Your Profile Information
content:
Users can update their profile details in the CultPass app:

- Go to 'My Account' > 'Profile Settings'
- They can change their display name, phone number, and notification preferences
- Email address changes require verification of the new email
- To change the email associated with the account, a verification link is sent to both old and new addresses
- Profile photo can be updated by tapping the avatar icon

**Suggested phrasing:**
"You can update your profile by going to 'My Account' > 'Profile Settings' in the CultPass app. If you need to change your email address, you'll receive a verification link at both your old and new email addresses for security."
tags: account, profile, email, name, settings, personal

title: Premium Experience Upgrade Guide
content:
Users can upgrade their subscription tier to access premium experiences:

- Basic tier: 4 standard experiences per month
- Premium tier: 4 standard + 2 premium experiences per month, plus priority booking
- Upgrade is available in 'My Account' > 'Manage Plan' > 'Upgrade'
- The price difference is prorated for the current billing cycle
- Premium users also get early access to new experience listings (48 hours before general availability)
- Downgrade back to basic is effective at the end of the current billing cycle

**Suggested phrasing:**
"You can upgrade to Premium in 'My Account' > 'Manage Plan'. Premium gives you 2 additional premium experiences per month plus priority booking and early access to new listings. The upgrade cost is prorated for this billing cycle."
tags: premium, upgrade, subscription, tier, plan, pricing

title: How to Transfer a Reservation to Another Person
content:
If a user wants to transfer their reservation to someone else:

- Transfers are allowed up to 24 hours before the experience start time
- The recipient must have an active CultPass account
- Go to 'My Reservations' > select the reservation > 'Transfer'
- Enter the recipient's email address associated with their CultPass account
- The original reservation holder will receive a confirmation once the transfer is complete
- Premium experiences can only be transferred to other Premium subscribers

**Suggested phrasing:**
"You can transfer your reservation up to 24 hours before the event. Go to 'My Reservations', select the booking, and tap 'Transfer'. The person receiving the reservation must have an active CultPass account."

title: What to Do If an Experience Is Sold Out
content:
When a user wants to attend a sold-out experience:

- Check if a waitlist is available for the experience (shown on the experience detail page)
- If available, the user can join the waitlist and will be notified if a spot opens
- Suggest browsing similar experiences in the same category or location
- Some experiences have multiple sessions — check if alternative dates are available
- Premium subscribers get priority on waitlists

**Suggested phrasing:**
"This experience is currently sold out, but you can join the waitlist to be notified if a spot opens up. You might also want to check for similar experiences or alternative dates. Premium members get priority on waitlists."
tags: reservation, waitlist, sold out, availability, booking

title: CultPass Referral Program
content:
CultPass offers a referral program for existing subscribers:

- Each user has a unique referral code found in 'My Account' > 'Refer a Friend'
- When a new user signs up using the referral code, both the referrer and new user receive 1 bonus experience credit
- There is no limit to the number of referrals a user can make
- Bonus credits expire 90 days after being awarded
- Referral credits cannot be combined with other promotions
- The referral program is available to all active subscribers (basic and premium)

**Suggested phrasing:**
"You can find your referral code in 'My Account' > 'Refer a Friend'. When someone signs up with your code, you both get a bonus experience credit! There's no limit to how many friends you can refer."
tags: referral, discount, invite, rewards, promotion, friends

title: Contacting Human Support and Escalation Policy
content:
When automated support cannot resolve an issue:

- The AI agent should clearly inform the user that their case is being escalated
- Provide an estimated response time: typically within 24 hours for standard issues, 4 hours for urgent/billing issues
- Ensure all relevant context (ticket ID, issue summary, steps already taken) is passed to the human agent
- Users can also reach human support directly via email at support@cultpass.com or by calling +55 11 4000-0000 during business hours (Mon-Fri, 9am-6pm BRT)
- For urgent issues (account security, unauthorized charges), prioritize immediate escalation

**Suggested phrasing:**
"I'm going to escalate your case to our specialized support team. They'll review your issue and get back to you within 24 hours. For urgent matters, you can also reach us at support@cultpass.com or call +55 11 4000-0000 during business hours."
tags: escalation, human, support, contact, help, urgent
